plugverse-launch-film.title: What I made
plugverse-launch-film.body: A one-minute film for PlugVerse's launch. I directed and edited it in DaVinci Resolve and Fusion.

plugverse-launch-film.title: Why it belongs here
plugverse-launch-film.body: I built the product and made the film that introduced it. You can watch the full cut here, then see the product it was made for.

plugverse-launch-film.title: What I'm learning
plugverse-launch-film.body: Making something I'm proud of is one part. Figuring out how to get it in front of the artists who need it is the next part.

plugverse-product.title: I use it myself
plugverse-product.body: I play in Rubber and handle our bookings. When someone reaches out about a gig, I use PlugVerse to send an offer with the event details. They accept and sign there.

plugverse-product.title: What I built
plugverse-product.body: I built PlugVerse solo with Claude Code, working across the product, design, front end, and back end. The screens here are from the actual product.

plugverse-product.title: What matters next
plugverse-product.body: Getting other artists to use it for their own gigs. That's what I'm working on now.
